05 / something from my heart

A letter for the days
you miss me, too.

Not everything fits into a birthday text. So here's the longer version.

Amy, my girl. Happy 20th birthday. ♡

It's kind of unreal that we've known each other since 7th grade and now we're twenty. We've grown up through so many versions of ourselves, and I'm so grateful that somewhere along the way, I got you as my best friend.

I miss you more than I probably say. I miss being around you, sharing the little things, laughing at things nobody else would understand, and having you close enough that a normal day could turn into a memory. Distance might steal some of our time together, but it will never make you less important to me.

I hope twenty brings you the kind of happiness that stays. I hope you feel loved in the smallest moments, proud of the person you're becoming, and brave enough to go after every beautiful thing you want. And whenever life gets heavy, I hope you remember you have someone in your corner. Always.

Thank you for being part of my growing up. Here's to every chapter we've lived and all the ones waiting for us. No matter how old we get, a little part of me will always be that kid from 7th grade who got lucky enough to know you.

I love you endlessly. Happy birthday, Amy. Let's make more memories soon. 🩷
your best friend, always ♡
